up: Retrieve a list of compounds that have been tested against the human adenosine A1 receptor in assays where the assay organism is Homo sapiens. For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES string. Ensure that only compounds with available canonical SMILES are included in the results.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN activities a ON md.molregno = a.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.pref_name = 'Adenosine A1 receptor' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
